sub_limits.note: All covers up to Sum Insured

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (reducible to 12mo via optional channel-level add-on)
ped_waiting.note: Optional PED wait modification to 24 or 12 months available at channel level

maternity.note: Maternity excluded under standard exclusions; Parenthood add-on covers maternity with 2yr wait

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of Base SI per year irrespective of claims, max 100%

restoration.note: Triggers on partial or complete exhaustion; usable for same or different illness

modern_treatments.note: No specific sub-limit mentioned; covered under hospitalisation expenses

consumables.note: Protect Benefit (non-medical expenses cover) not available for Optima Suraksha

global_cover.note: India only plan; no global cover option

notable_exclusions: Maternity, congenital external anomalies, stem cell harvesting, cosmetic surgery, OPD treatment, hearing aids/spectacles
optional_riders: Aggregate deductible, Emergency Air Ambulance, Daily Cash for Shared Room, PED wait modification, Critical Illness add-on, Hospital Cash add-on, Personal Accident rider, Parenthood add-on
